item.title: The Resolv hack: How one compromised key printed $23M
item.description:
📝 After minting the unbacked USR, the attacker quickly converted it into a staked version (wstUSR), then gradually swapped it into other stablecoins and eventually into ETH. How Resolv’s token minting is supposed to workUnderstanding how this attack happened requires first understanding Resolv’s minting design. With control over the KMS environment, the attacker could use Resolv’s own minting key to authorize any minting operation they chose.
🔗 Read more: https://www.chainalysis.com/blog/lessons-from-the-resolv-hack/

item.title: Cuba's Fragile Power Grid Finds a Powerful New Partner
item.description:
📝 Once energy was restored 29 hours later, President Miguel Diaz-Canel blasted Washington’s "almost daily public threats against Cuba. Cuba has struggled to reach its own goals of renewable energy expansion and integration over the past decade, with renewables contributing just 9 percent of the national energy mix at present, but increased support from China could change that. According to British energy think tank Ember, China shipped $5 million worth of solar equipment to Cuba in 2023.
🔗 Read more: https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-General/Cubas-Fragile-Power-Grid-Finds-a-Powerful-New-Partner.html
